# DropSpace v0.3.0-beta.28

<!-- update-summary: Beta 28 restores player-agnostic lyric matching, adds explicit preferred/backup/remaining source order, fixes lyric wheel ownership, and makes NetEase installation detection offline. -->

## Changed

- Unified online lyric lookup around title, track artist, album artist, album and duration
  evidence, including bounded title-only recovery for every provider.
- Added an optional backup lyrics provider plus an independent switch for searching the remaining
  unselected providers; without either, lookup contacts only the preferred provider.
- Retried a missing lyric lookup when the same media session later publishes its duration,
  without weakening wrong-artist, version-conflict or stale-track rejection.
- Made passive NetEase enhancement inspection local-only: managed bytes are hash-checked and
  existing BetterNCM/InfLink installations are recognized without checking for updates.
- Moved an installed NetEase enhancement card to the bottom of Music and gave Now Playing and
  the bounded lyric viewport clear native card surfaces, including the media source in the
  playback card. Lyrics now consume wheel input without simultaneously moving the outer page.

## Validation

See `docs/dev/beta28-media-ui-audit.md` for automated coverage, real Apple Music/DropSpace
desktop checks, release validation and remaining boundaries.
